meta_description:
187 likes, 5 comments - bigleemurali on October 9, 2026: "A six-pack doesn’t automatically mean you’re fit. Neither does a 10K run or a 200 kg deadlift. 👇

Real fitness has TWO parts:
✅ Achieve your goal — fat loss, muscle gain, strength or performance.
✅ Protect your health — blood sugar, lipids, liver, kidney function and other relevant health markers.

You can look fit, lift heavy and still neglect your health.

Don’t just train for a better body. Build a healthier body.

Save this Reel as a reminder that fitness is more than what you see in the mirror. 📌

Follow @bigleemurali for practical, science-based fitness, nutrition and strength training advice.

#Fitness #BodyTransformation #StrengthTraining #HealthyLifestyle #FitnessIndia".
